topics.name: ETL Pipeline Simulator
topics.concept: Extract, transform, load pipelines move data from sources through cleaning into warehouses on a schedule. The simulator models extraction, transformation rules, and loads with failure injection and retry. It teaches the batch backbone of analytics.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates source tables with dirty data needing cleaning.

topics.name: ELT Lakehouse Loader
topics.concept: ELT loads raw data first and transforms it inside the warehouse, exploiting cheap scalable compute. The loader simulates raw ingestion into zones then SQL-based transformations with lineage. It contrasts the modern pattern against classic ETL.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG fabricates raw events for zone promotion.

topics.name: CDC Stream Simulator
topics.concept: Change data capture streams row-level inserts, updates, and deletes from databases, keeping downstream systems fresh. The simulator emits binlog-style events with before and after images and ordering guarantees. It powers real-time replication.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG mutates tables producing change events.

topics.name: Tumbling Window Aggregator
topics.concept: Stream processors bucket events into fixed non-overlapping windows for counts and sums. The aggregator assigns events to windows handling out-of-order arrivals within lateness bounds. It is the simplest streaming aggregation.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG emits timestamped events with late arrivals.

topics.name: Sliding Window Aggregator
topics.concept: Sliding windows overlap, giving smooth moving averages over the last N minutes updated continuously. The aggregator maintains windows with efficient eviction of expired events. It powers rolling metrics.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG streams events for moving computations.
topics.real_world_use: Used in monitoring and fraud scoring.

topics.name: Session Window Tracker
topics.concept: Session windows group events by activity gaps, like a user's browsing session ending after 30 idle minutes. The tracker opens, extends, and closes sessions with timeout handling. It models behavior, not clock time.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates user sessions with idle gaps.

topics.name: Watermark Late Data Handler
topics.concept: Watermarks track event-time progress, letting streams decide when a window is complete despite late data. The handler advances watermarks with heuristics and routes too-late events to side outputs. It tames out-of-order streams.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG emits events with skewed lateness.
topics.real_world_use: Used in Flink and Beam pipelines.

topics.name: Exactly Once Simulator
topics.concept: Exactly-once processing needs idempotent sinks and transactional checkpoints, since networks deliver at-least-once. The simulator replays duplicates through checkpointed operators showing dedup at the sink. It demonstrates the hardest delivery guarantee.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG injects failures causing redelivery.

topics.name: Schema Evolution Checker
topics.concept: Schemas evolve: fields get added, renamed, or retyped, and compatibility rules decide what breaks consumers. The checker validates schema versions against backward, forward, and full compatibility. It governs contract changes.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG evolves schemas with safe and breaking changes.

topics.name: Data Quality Profiler
topics.concept: Profilers scan datasets computing null rates, distinct counts, and distributions per column, the first step of any quality program. The profiler flags anomalies like sudden null spikes against history. You cannot fix what you do not measure.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG fabricates tables with quality decay over time.

topics.name: Null Rate Monitor
topics.concept: A sudden jump in nulls means an upstream broke, and the monitor catches it per column per day. It tracks null fractions with change detection alerting on regime shifts. Silent schema drift becomes visible.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates column data with null injection events.

topics.name: Duplicate Detector
topics.concept: Duplicates sneak in through retries and double ingestion, corrupting counts. The detector finds exact and fuzzy duplicates on key sets with blocking for scale. Clean data starts with dedup.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG injects duplicates with typos.

topics.name: Distribution Drift Detector
topics.concept: When input distributions shift, models and reports silently degrade, so drift detection compares recent data to a reference. The detector uses statistical distance measures per feature with alert thresholds. It watches the data behind the model.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG drifts feature distributions over time.

topics.name: Metric Anomaly Detector
topics.concept: Business metrics like signups or revenue deserve anomaly detection tuned to seasonality. The detector decomposes trend and weekly patterns flagging residual outliers. It pages on the real drops, not the weekend dips.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG synthesizes KPIs with seasonal dips and true anomalies.
topics.real_world_use: Used by data teams watching business health.

topics.name: Lineage Tracker
topics.concept: Column-level lineage traces a dashboard number back through transforms to source tables, essential for impact analysis. The tracker builds the dependency graph from simulated pipeline definitions. It answers what breaks if this table changes.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates pipeline DAGs with column mappings.

topics.name: DAG Scheduler
topics.concept: Pipeline DAGs encode task dependencies, and the scheduler orders execution with retries and backfilling. The simulator runs DAGs showing parallel levels, failures, and recovery. It models Airflow-style orchestration.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG creates DAGs with flaky tasks.

topics.name: Backfill Runner
topics.concept: Backfills recompute history after logic fixes, needing careful partitioning to avoid overwhelming systems. The runner schedules historical partitions with concurrency limits and validation. It repairs the past safely.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG models partition workloads.

topics.name: Partition Pruner
topics.concept: Partition pruning skips irrelevant data, and the pruner shows how filter pushdown reduces scanned bytes. It evaluates query predicates against partition metadata. Fast queries start with pruning.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates partitioned data with stats.

topics.name: File Format Comparator
topics.concept: Row formats like CSV versus columnar Parquet differ hugely in scan speed and size. The comparator simulates reads and writes across formats measuring bytes and time. Format choice is architecture.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates tabular data for format tests.

topics.name: Columnar Stats Builder
topics.concept: Columnar formats store min-max and bloom filters per row group enabling skip. The builder computes zone maps over simulated row groups showing prune rates. Metadata makes big scans small.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG builds row groups with value ranges.

topics.name: Merge Compaction Simulator
topics.concept: Lakehouse tables accumulate small files that compaction merges for read performance. The simulator models file arrivals and compaction strategies measuring read amplification. It tunes the write-read tradeoff.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG streams small files into tables.
topics.real_world_use: Used managing Delta and Iceberg tables.

topics.name: Upsert Handler
topics.concept: Upserts merge new records into existing tables by key, handling late and out-of-order arrivals. The handler simulates merge-on-read versus copy-on-write with conflict resolution. It keeps tables current.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates record versions with conflicts.

topics.name: SCD Type 2 Builder
topics.concept: Slowly changing dimensions track history with effective dates and current flags instead of overwriting. The builder processes dimension changes emitting versioned rows. History becomes queryable.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG mutates dimension attributes over time.

topics.name: Star Schema Validator
topics.concept: Star schemas center facts on conformed dimensions, and the validator checks grain, keys, and referential integrity. It flags fan-out risks and degenerate dimensions. Clean modeling prevents wrong answers.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG builds schemas with modeling flaws.

topics.name: Data Contract Checker
topics.concept: Data contracts formalize producer promises: schema, freshness, and quality SLAs. The checker validates deliveries against contracts flagging breaches. Trust becomes enforceable.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG produces deliveries with violations.

topics.name: PII Tagger
topics.concept: Finding PII across datasets is step one of privacy compliance, so the tagger scans columns with pattern and name heuristics. It classifies direct and quasi-identifiers with confidence. Discovery precedes protection.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG fabricates tables with embedded PII.

topics.name: Tokenization Engine
topics.concept: Tokenization replaces sensitive values with random tokens keeping a secure vault mapping for reversal. The engine tokenizes columns with format preservation and vault storage. Analytics continue without the raw secrets.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates sensitive columns.
topics.real_world_use: Used in PCI and healthcare analytics.

topics.name: Masking Engine
topics.concept: Dynamic masking hides sensitive values from unauthorized roles while keeping data usable. The engine applies role-based masking rules to query results. Least privilege for data.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG simulates queries from different roles.

topics.name: Sampling Engine
topics.concept: Sampling speeds exploration: random, stratified, and reservoir methods each suit different questions. The engine draws samples estimating how well they represent the full data. Fast answers with known error.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG builds skewed datasets for sampling tests.

topics.name: Data Catalog Search
topics.concept: Data catalogs make datasets discoverable with metadata search and ownership. The search indexes simulated dataset metadata ranking by relevance. Findability fights data swamps.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG creates dataset metadata.

topics.name: Dataset Versioning Tool
topics.concept: Versioning datasets with content hashes enables reproducible experiments and safe rollbacks. The tool snapshots simulated datasets tracking diffs between versions. Data gets git-like discipline.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG evolves datasets across versions.

topics.name: Feature Store Simulator
topics.concept: Feature stores serve consistent features for training and inference, killing training-serving skew. The simulator manages offline and online stores with point-in-time correctness. It operationalizes ML features.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates feature values over time.

topics.name: Training Serving Skew Checker
topics.concept: Skew between training and serving features silently degrades models, so the checker compares distributions. It flags diverged features with severity. Models stay honest.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG drifts serving features from training.

topics.name: Label Tracker
topics.concept: Labels arrive late and get revised, complicating training data assembly. The tracker manages label versions with arrival times and corrections. Ground truth gets versioned.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG emits labels with delays and fixes.

topics.name: Annotation Queue Manager
topics.concept: Human labeling needs queues with prioritization, agreement checks, and quality sampling. The manager assigns tasks to annotators measuring throughput and agreement. Label quality becomes managed.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG simulates annotator speed and accuracy.

topics.name: Pipeline Cost Estimator
topics.concept: Data pipelines cost compute and storage per run, and the estimator prices DAGs before they run. It models task resources and data volumes into dollar forecasts. Budgets meet pipelines.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG scales pipeline workloads.
topics.real_world_use: Used by data teams forecasting spend.

topics.name: Freshness Monitor
topics.concept: Stale data breaks decisions quietly, so freshness monitors track the age of the newest record per table. It alerts when pipelines miss their SLAs. Timeliness becomes a metric.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG ages tables with pipeline delays.

topics.name: Pipeline Dead Letter Inspector
topics.concept: Bad records that fail parsing land in dead letters awaiting triage. The inspector samples them classifying failure causes and supports replay after fixes. No record left behind.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG corrupts records with varied defects.

topics.name: Replay Tool
topics.concept: Replaying historical data through fixed logic validates pipeline changes. The tool reprocesses date ranges comparing outputs to baselines. Changes get evidence.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG provides historical inputs.

topics.name: Idempotency Checker
topics.concept: Retried writes must not double-count, so the checker verifies idempotent keys and dedup logic. It replays operations asserting single effect. Exactly-once effects from at-least-once delivery.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG duplicates writes randomly.

topics.name: Dedup Engine
topics.concept: Dedup engines remove duplicates at scale with key-based and fuzzy matching. The engine processes streams maintaining seen-sets with memory bounds. Clean streams stay clean.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG injects duplicates into streams.

topics.name: Ordering Guarantee Tester
topics.concept: Ordering promises range from none to per-key to global, each with costs. The tester verifies delivered order against the promised guarantee under failures. Promises get proven.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG shuffles deliveries under faults.

topics.name: Backpressure Simulator
topics.concept: Fast producers overwhelm slow consumers unless backpressure signals slow the source. The simulator models buffer limits with blocking and dropping strategies. Flow control keeps pipelines alive.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG varies producer bursts.

topics.name: Throughput Benchmark
topics.concept: Throughput benchmarks measure records per second across configurations, finding bottlenecks. The tool sweeps parallelism and batch sizes reporting throughput curves. Numbers replace guesses.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG models stage processing times.

topics.name: Latency Histogram Builder
topics.concept: Latency histograms reveal the distribution that averages hide. The builder buckets event latencies computing percentiles over time. Tail behavior becomes visible.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates latencies with tail spikes.

topics.name: Sink Connector Simulator
topics.concept: Sink connectors write streams to warehouses and lakes with batching and exactly-once semantics. The simulator models flush policies and failure recovery. It bridges streaming and storage.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG streams records with sink faults.

topics.name: Source Connector Simulator
topics.concept: Source connectors poll or tail origins into streams with offset management. The simulator models polling intervals, change capture, and offset commits. Ingestion starts here.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG mutates source systems.

topics.name: Schema Registry Lite
topics.concept: A lightweight registry versions event schemas with compatibility checks. It serves schemas to producers and consumers validating evolution. Contracts stay central.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG evolves event schemas.

topics.name: Avro Compat Checker
topics.concept: Avro's schema resolution rules decide which evolutions are safe for readers and writers. The checker tests reader-writer pairs against the spec. Binary compatibility gets verified.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG pairs evolving schemas.

topics.name: Dead Partition Detector
topics.concept: Partitions that stop receiving data signal broken upstream jobs. The detector watches arrival times per partition alerting on silence. Missing data gets noticed.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG simulates partition arrivals with outages.

topics.name: Skew Analyzer
topics.concept: Data skew, a few hot keys holding most records, cripples parallel processing. The analyzer measures key distribution recommending salting or repartitioning. Balance restores speed.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates skewed key distributions.

topics.name: Small Files Compactor
topics.concept: Small files multiply metadata overhead and slow scans, so compaction merges them. The tool simulates file sizes and compaction policies measuring scan improvement. Fewer, bigger files win.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG drips small files into partitions.

topics.name: Retention Enforcer
topics.concept: Retention policies delete or archive aging data for cost and compliance. The enforcer applies rules to partitions with audit trails. Data lifetimes stay governed.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG ages partitions.

topics.name: Archive Tiering Planner
topics.concept: Cold data belongs in cheap archive tiers with retrieval tradeoffs. The planner analyzes access patterns recommending tier moves with savings. Hot data stays hot, cold data gets cheap.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG cools dataset access over time.

topics.name: Restore Tester
topics.concept: Archived data must actually restore within promised times, so the tester measures retrieval latency. It validates RTO for archive tiers. Promises get proven.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG issues restore requests.

topics.name: Data Mesh Domain Mapper
topics.concept: Data mesh organizes data by domain with federated governance, and the mapper charts domain ownership of datasets. It visualizes dependencies across domains. Decentralization stays coherent.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG assigns datasets to domains.

topics.name: Stream Table Joiner
topics.concept: Joining streams with tables enriches events with reference data, needing careful state management. The joiner simulates temporal joins with versioned tables. Enrichment stays correct in time.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG versions reference data over time.

topics.name: Change Data Quality Gate
topics.concept: Quality gates block bad batches before they poison downstream tables. The gate runs checks on each batch with quarantine for failures. Bad data stops at the door.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG delivers batches with defects.

topics.name: Data Observability Scorecard
topics.concept: Scorecards roll freshness, quality, and lineage coverage into one health view per dataset. The generator computes scores with drill-downs. Data health becomes visible.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG fabricates pillar metrics.
